title: A straight through cut across the panel separating the tower corners
rationale: The panel has a through saw cut in from each side edge at y = 600 (prior removal). The program cuts across between them in two straight cuts at C = 250; when the second meets the first (its line 18), the part with tower 2's anchor a2 is cut off from tower 1's (safety-model 7.4); the witness is the separating piece. The tool never reaches an edge (that would be T-AREA): the declared saw cuts complete the separation.
